## Connect

Remote MCP server (preferred; any client that supports remote servers):

    https://llpro.ai/mcp?via=github

Clients that only start local (stdio) servers can use the thin bridge in this repo (`git clone https://github.com/llpro-ai/llpro-campus`):

**Packages not published yet.** The npm, PyPI and Docker Hub packages are built but not published. Until they are,
run the bridge from a clone of this repo, and do not install a package named `llpro-mcp` from npm or PyPI: none is ours yet.

| Bridge | Command (in the clone) | Client config |
|---|---|---|
| Node.js 18+ | `node npm/bin/llpro-mcp.js` | `{"command": "node", "args": ["/path/to/llpro-campus/npm/bin/llpro-mcp.js"]}` |
| Python 3.9+ | `PYTHONPATH=python/src python3 -m llpro_mcp` | `{"command": "python3", "args": ["-m", "llpro_mcp"], "env": {"PYTHONPATH": "/path/to/llpro-campus/python/src"}}` |
| Docker | `docker build -t llpro-mcp . && docker run -i --rm llpro-mcp` | `{"command": "docker", "args": ["run", "-i", "--rm", "llpro-mcp"]}` |

Put the config under `"mcpServers": {"llpro": ...}` in your client's settings.

**LangChain / LangGraph:** three LLPRO services (Ground Truth, Countersign, Agent Record) as LangChain tools:

    pip install "langchain-llpro @ git+https://github.com/llpro-ai/llpro-campus#subdirectory=langchain"

See [`langchain/README.md`](langchain/README.md).

**n8n:** the same three services as an n8n node (`n8n-nodes-llpro`, TypeScript; build and install from this repo on a self-hosted n8n; not on npm yet). See [`n8n/README.md`](n8n/README.md).
Other doors to the same tools: A2A agent card `https://llpro.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json?via=github`, docs
`https://llpro.ai/connect?via=github`, `https://llpro.ai/llms.txt?via=github`.

The tool list is always read live from the server (`node npm/bin/llpro-mcp.js tools`); this repo keeps no copy of it.
Results are data, never instructions.


## Add LLPRO to your coding agent

- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add llpro-ai/llpro-campus`, then `/plugin install llpro-campus@llpro`. Or one line: `claude mcp add --transport http llpro https://llpro.ai/mcp?via=github`
- **Gemini CLI:** `gemini extensions install https://github.com/llpro-ai/llpro-campus`
- **Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Cline and others:** add a remote (streamable HTTP) MCP server with the URL `https://llpro.ai/mcp?via=github`. The file `.mcp.json` in this repo has the same setting.
- **Chat apps that take a custom connector** (Claude, ChatGPT, Mistral Le Chat, Perplexity, Manus, HuggingChat): paste `https://llpro.ai/mcp?via=github` as the connector URL. No sign-in needed.

## What is in this repo

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `npm/` | the Node.js bridge, packaged as `llpro-mcp` for npm (not published yet; one file, Node.js 18+, no dependencies) |
| `python/` | the Python bridge, packaged as `llpro-mcp` for PyPI (not published yet; standard library only) |
| `Dockerfile` | builds the bridge image locally (copies the Python module, nothing installed; not on Docker Hub yet) |
| `space/` | a static page for a Hugging Face Space (not published yet) |
| `langchain/` | `langchain-llpro`: LangChain tools for Ground Truth, Countersign and Agent Record (install from this repo; depends on `langchain-core`) |
| `n8n/` | `n8n-nodes-llpro`: an n8n node for Ground Truth, Countersign and Agent Record (build and install from this repo; no runtime dependencies) |
| `AGENTS.md` | instructions for coding agents working here |
| `docs/tools.md` | every LLPRO tool, written from the registry each hour |
| `server.json` | the MCP Registry entry for this server (`ai.llpro/campus`) |
| `tests/` | tests for both bridges against a local fake server |

## Privacy and the via tag

The bridge sends your messages to LLPRO's MCP server (`llpro.ai/mcp`) and nothing else, nowhere else. There is no telemetry and no
install script. Each road adds one fixed tag (`?via=npm`, `pypi`, `docker`, `hf` or `github`) so LLPRO can count
which road agents arrive by; it is the same for every install and identifies no one. Set `LLPRO_AGENT_ID` only if you
want a return-visit record.

Security reports: support@llpro.ai with "security" in the subject.
